source: User-supplied Wave Race 64 USA revision 1 ROM on VENGEANCE
method: Original music sequences and ADPCM instrument samples extracted locally; normal-race variation resolved before sequence conversion; rendered offline on EVO X2 and encoded into standalone MP3 files.
tools: FFmpeg / libmp3lame installed on EVO X2
mix: Original compositions and instrument samples. Offline MIDI/SoundFont rendering approximates the game's envelopes and reverb; this is not a bit-exact N64 RSP recording. Source sequence waits determine loop duration; a second traversal retains release and reverb tails. Final-lap variants are not included.
